{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.06

|gr1= Multiplayer
|gr2= Object Detection

|serverExec= server

|descr= Returns a list of [[getPlayerID|player ids]] of all the users on an MP server.
{{Feature|informative|This also lists [[Arma 3: Headless Client|Headless Clients]].}}

|s1= [[allUsers]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[String]]s - user network IDs (see [[getPlayerID]], [[getUserInfo]])

|x1= <sqf>
if (isServer) then
{
	private _allUserIDs = allUsers;
	for "_i" from 0 to (count _allUserIds - 1) do
	{
		diag_log format ["User #%1 ID: %2", _i + 1, _allUserIds select _i];
	};
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[getUserInfo]] [[getPlayerID]] [[allPlayers]] [[allCurators]] [[allGroups]] [[allDead]] [[allUnits]] [[switchableUnits]] [[playableUnits]] [[vehicles]] [[allUnitsUAV]] [[allDeadMen]] [[isPlayer]] [[playersNumber]]
}}
